name: move toward own best and group best
mechanism: each candidate keeps a velocity updated toward its own best-seen position and the group's best-seen position with random weights, and moves by that velocity each round

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Particle swarm' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms:
List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Bees algorithm': a search algorithm which mimics the food foraging behavior of swarms of honey bees

requires: a continuous space with a distance
fails_when: premature convergence to the group best
